name: swipe-actions
title: SwipeActions
description: A row that slides aside to reveal actions underneath (iOS Mail style), on an interruptible spring — by finger, pen, mouse or a two-finger trackpad swipe — with a full swipe that commits, and a More menu that is the same actions for everyone who doesn’t swipe.
